mission_08: React.memo(Component) does a shallow comparison of props. If props are the same, the component skips re-rendering.
useMemo(() => expensiveComputation(a, b), [a, b]) only recalculates when a or b changes. Without it, the computation runs every render.
useCallback(() => { ... }, [deps]) returns a memoized function. Use it when passing callbacks to memoized children to prevent unnecessary re-renders.
